=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml, about L1249-1252 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The force-judge lookup omits `--support-sha`, so a marker from an older support version can be accepted as trusted same-head.
  WHY: After the support commit changes so the resolver no longer refuses, the old marker can still set `force_rb_judge_conflict_skip=true` and skip the updated resolver.
- tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py, L9601-9602 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: `_step_if_line` and `test_force_rb_judge_host_only_marker_skips_conflict_steps_but_not_the_judge` are defined after `if __name__ == "__main__": raise SystemExit(main())`, and `main()` does not call the new test.
  WHY: CI runs this file as a script and exits before the new test definitions run, so the workflow-wiring assertions are not enforced.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml together with scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py, review_autofix.yml L1249-1264 uses `count`/`reason` from `count_identical_failures` (workflow_failure_heal.py L2631-2654) | severity=NIT | confidence=[2]
  PROBLEM: A same-head marker with an invalid `fp` is skipped, allowing an older valid host-only marker to supply the reason.
  WHY: A newer unverifiable marker is ignored, so the older marker can cause the gate to skip conflict detection.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml, new block L1230-1268 | severity=NIT | confidence=[2]
  PROBLEM: The host-only skip is only evaluated where the fingerprint-cap logic runs.
  WHY: If the cap is disabled, support is unverified, or the base was retargeted, the force-judge run keeps the resolver-refusal loop with no `AUTOFIX_FORCE_RB_JUDGE_CONFLICT_SKIP` line explaining why the skip did not run; the behavior is fail-safe but hard to diagnose.
- README.md, row `REVIEW_FORCE_RB_JUDGE_HOST_ONLY_SKIP_ENABLED`, "the comments the fingerprint cap reads; no extra API call" | severity=NIT | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: The documented API-cost statement is inaccurate for a force_rb_judge dispatch.
  WHY: The new block calls `gate_fetch_marker_comments`, which does one `gh api user` plus a paginated comments GET.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Additions to `agents.md` go in an `agents.d/<issue-or-pr>-<slug>.md` fragment. `agents.d/README.md` L3-4 says "Never add to `agents.md` directly (CLAUDE.md §30)".
  Expected change site: new `agents.d/6743-force-rb-judge-host-only-conflict-skip.md`. It would hold `<!-- agents: section="Workflow architecture" -->` and `<!-- agents: section="Stable log prefixes (contractual)" -->` blocks.
  Evidence of absence: No `agents.d/6743-*` file exists; the agents.d directory holds only other issues' fragments and the README. The PR edits `agents.md` directly in three hunks: the narrative in the review-autofix bullet (L118-128), the registry bullet (L2335) and the `LOG_PREFIX.name=` line (L2593). CI runs `scripts/assemble_agents.py check` and the fragments are folded at release time, so direct edits break the convention and can conflict with concurrent PRs.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
